alt: Four different bundles of faceted paper plants, each tied by the same satin ribbon.
prompt: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, nearly square (about 1:1), safe to crop to 4:5 around the centre. On a low, calm faceted paper hill, four small bundles of flat faceted paper plants stand in a loose row, each a different kind: a sheaf of slender leaves, a branch of soft blossoms, a cluster of broad leaves and a tuft of tall grasses, in Partner Navy, slate blue and pale blue facets. One continuous satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan enters from the lower left, loops once around the stem of each bundle and runs out at the right edge: ready-made packages for different industries, tied together by one team. Keep the bundles in the middle and lower two thirds and the top third a calm, open Daylight sky. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
